title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Microsoft open-sources APM (Agent Package Manager) for skills, prompts, plugins and MCP servers
bullets.summary: Microsoft released APM (MIT), a dependency manager that installs agent skills, prompts, instructions, plugins and MCP servers from one apm.yml manifest across nine harnesses incl. Claude Code and Cursor (Nov 7; via dev.to AI Daily Digest, repo not independently reviewed).
bullets.how: The Construct: a single manifest to version and reproduce our skills/MCP fleet across Claude Code, Hermes and Cursor-style harnesses; evaluate against our installed-skills registry. PRAGMA: reproducible agent environments for client deployments. Brand 9 Signs: indirect.

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.319: background MCP tasks + permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting
bullets.summary: Claude Code 2.1.319 (Nov 6) lets MCP tasks move to the background and adds a permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting setting so unattended runs deny rather than stall on approval prompts (via munderdiffl.in / Releasebot summary).
bullets.how: The Construct: denyInsteadOfPrompting is directly useful for scheduled/unattended routines like this one; background MCP tasks help long-running tool calls. PRAGMA: safer unattended-agent defaults to recommend to clients. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Google ADK 2.14.0 graduates A2A protocol, evals, execution environments and core runtime to stable
bullets.summary: Google's Agent Development Kit 2.14.0 (Nov 7) is a major release moving the A2A protocol, evaluation, execution environments and runtime to stable (via dev.to digest; release notes not independently reviewed).
bullets.how: The Construct: stable A2A is a candidate interop layer between agents on different stacks; watch rather than adopt. PRAGMA: relevant for clients standardized on Google Cloud. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Perplexity launches Teammates: always-on work agents
bullets.summary: Perplexity shipped Teammates, always-running AI agents that work alongside a team instead of waiting in a chat window (Nov 6; via dev.to digest citing The Verge).
bullets.how: The Construct: competitor validation of the persistent-agent model; compare their scoping/permissions to our Pulse/Scout-style agents. PRAGMA: reference point when pitching AI-operator retainers. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash goes GA with 15-second native video clips and conversational editing
bullets.summary: Google DeepMind made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available (Gemini API, Workspace Vids): native video up to 15s, conversational editing, pricing 30% below Omni 1.1 (via dev.to digest).
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: cheap short-form video for social/product clips is a fit for the social-content flywheel; test quality on sign-install and product shots. The Construct: another video-gen backend option beside Higgsfield. PRAGMA: low-cost creative generation for clients.

praxis_lesson: Tooling is converging on package-managed, unattended-safe agents (APM manifests, A2A going stable, deny-instead-of-prompt permissions): reproducibility and non-interactive safety defaults are now the practical moat for running agent fleets, so version the skill/MCP set and make every unattended run fail closed. (Caveat: Items are secondhand from dev.to / munderdiffl.in / Releasebot roundups (Nov 6-7); no verified new frontier-model, signage/CRM/DAM MCP, agent-platform funding or new arXiv paper news found, so those categories are omitted. This refreshes the earlier same-day run.)
